text: The purpose of this report is to provide an update on the Nathan Phillips Square Bike Station and the planned increase to the number of secure bicycle parking spaces at City Hall. Bike stations are secure, indoor parking facilities for bicycles. Protected with 24 hour video surveillance, they provide safe, all-day parking to safeguard bicycles against theft, vandalism and bad weather. Only people who register to use a bike station can access the facilities. Construction of a bike station at Nathan Phillips Square is currently underway and the facility is scheduled to open in August 2018. The facility will have a capacity for 175 bicycles.

The Government Management Committee: 1. Requested the General Manager, Transportation Services continue to explore additional secure bicycle parking spaces at City Hall, following the opening of the facility, given that the current wait list for bike lockers exceeds the capacity at the new Nathan Phillips Square bike station.
